researchDecisions.decision: Offer purposeful exploration plus authored support, not unguided discovery
researchDecisions.strength: Meta-analysis of guidance comparisons across inquiry studies
researchDecisions.limitations: Limited age-specific evidence; guidance categories and tasks vary; no universal recovery ladder
researchDecisions.validation: Playtest novice/struggling paths and assistance accounting

researchDecisions.decision: Explain the mechanism and useful next action after a mistake
researchDecisions.strength: Broad random-effects meta-analysis, with moderator and limitation discussion inspected
researchDecisions.limitations: High heterogeneity, publication/reporting bias and varying comparators; more information is not a licence for long feedback
researchDecisions.validation: Trace each error to feedback; test whether the next independent task improves

researchDecisions.decision: Build from sensible voltage/current/resistance reasoning and counterexample tests
researchDecisions.strength: 2024 primary multi-university conceptual-response research; methods and implications inspected
researchDecisions.limitations: University samples; context-sensitive ideas, not fixed learner labels or a causal trial of this app
researchDecisions.validation: Feedback addresses current-used-up/fixed-current reasoning; fresh layouts test transfer

researchDecisions.decision: Use series sums, parallel conductance sums and P=VI in a bounded ideal model
researchDecisions.strength: Established theory checked in textbook sections and AQA
researchDecisions.limitations: No unrestricted electronics solver; ideal wires/source/resistors; no transients or heating-dependent resistance
researchDecisions.validation: Independent hand calculations, conservation invariants and open/fault boundary tests

researchDecisions.decision: Provide tap/click and keyboard alternatives to dragging
researchDecisions.limitations: Standards compliance is not established by screenshots; actual reader/device experience may differ
researchDecisions.validation: Drive real interactions, focus, text alternatives, reduced motion and text expansion

researchDecisions.decision: Offer hints, representation, worked example, prerequisite, retry and escape
researchDecisions.strength: Owner contract plus guided-inquiry/feedback evidence motivates support
researchDecisions.limitations: Exact ladder and idle cutoff are hypotheses; inactivity alone does not show difficulty
researchDecisions.validation: Record help; assisted paths never give independent credit; owner revision
